# openstatus_status_page_component_group (Resource)

Manages a component group on an OpenStatus status page. Groups organize related components together.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "openstatus_status_page_component_group" "infrastructure" {
  page_id      = openstatus_status_page.main.id
  name         = "Infrastructure"
  default_open = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `page_id` (String) ID of the status page this group belongs to. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `name` (String) Name of the component group (1–256 characters).

### Optional

- `default_open` (Boolean) Whether the group should be expanded by default on the status page. Defaults to `false`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the component group.
- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the group was created.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the group was last updated.

## Import

Import using the status page ID and group ID separated by a slash:

```shell
terraform import openstatus_status_page_component_group.example <page_id>/<group_id>
```
